m: 2. अपी (√ इ), (Ved.) अप्य्-एति to go in or near; to enter into or upon; to come near, approach (also in copulation, RV. ii, 43, 2 ind.p. अपीत्या); to partake, have a share in; to join to pour out (as a river).
a: अपी — [अपि-इ] {c2c} P. (Mostly Vedic) 1 To go in or near, enter into or upon, approach. --2 To have a share in, partake of, suffer; जरामृत्युं पुनरेवापियंति Muṇḍ. --3 To join, flow, flow into, dissolve, be resolved into; स्वमपीतो भवति तस्मादेनं स्वपितीत्याचक्षते Ch. Up. --4 To die. --5 To pour out (as a river).

v: tri॰ apicyavate sOndaryyAdDIyate api + cyu--qa atolopa upasargadIrGaH na॰ ta॰ । 1 atisundare “apIcyadarSanaM sOmyaM sarvalokanamaskftamiti” vfha॰ “apIcyaveSaM dviBujaM sOmyAkAraM sudarSanamiti” yamamUrttilakzaRam, api + anca--kvip apyaN tatra sADu yat aYcateratolope pUrvva dIrGaH । 2 antarhite । “yadAviryadapIcyaM devAso asti duzkftamiti” f॰ 8, 47, 13, apIcyamantarhitam BA॰ 3 guhye “marttAnAM manuzyARAmapIcyam” f॰ 8, 39, 6, “apIcyaM guhyamiti” BA॰ ।
m: अपीच्य mfn. (3, 4) (fr. अपि-अञ्च्), secret, hidden, RV.
a: अपीच्य — a. 1 Very handsome or beautiful (अतिसुंदर). --2 Secret, concealed, hidden.
अपीजु — a. Ved. Impelling, stirring up.

s: klI, (apInAya asTUlatvAya sIyate kalpate, apIna + so + karmmakarttarikaH । pInasAt rogaviSezAt BinnaM naYsamAsaH .) pInasarogaH । iti raBasaH ॥ tadrahite tri ॥
v: pu॰ apInAya apInatvAya sIyate kalpate so karmmakarttari ka । 1 pInasaroge tadvivaraRaM pInasaSabde ।
m: अपी-नस m. (अपी for अपि; cf. पी-नस), dryness of the nose, want of the pituitary secretion and loss of smell, cold, Suśr.
a: अपीनसः — [अपीनाय, अपीनत्वाय सीयते कल्पते कर्मकर्तरि क Tv.] Dryness of the nose; cold (in the head), rheum, catarrh; see पीनस.

m: अ-पीडन n. not giving pain, gentleness, kindness.

s: puM, (pA + karmmaRi ktaH । na pItaH, naYsamAsaH .) pItaBinnavarRaH । tadviSizwe akftapAne ca tri iti naYsamastapItaSabdasyEtAvarTO ॥
v: tri॰ api + iRa--kta । 1 vilayaprApte vilIne, “sAmya । tadA sampannoBavati svamapIto Bavati tasmAdenaM svapitItyAcakzate svaMhyapItoBavatIti” SA॰ BA॰ DftA SrutiH । BAve kta । 1 vilaye 2 apagamane na॰ । pItavarRRaBinne pu॰ tadvati tri॰ । pItaM pAnakarmma 3 tadBinne tri॰ ।
m: 1. अपीत mfn. gone into, entered, ŚBr. x (used for the etym. of स्वपिति), ChUp. (cf. स्वाप्यया.)

v: strI api + iRa--ktin । 1 vilaye 2 apagame 3 pralaye ca । “apItOtadvatprasaNgAdasamaYjamama” SA॰ sU॰ । ADAre ktin । 4 saMgrAme । “purA yat sUrastamaso apItestamadrivaH” iti f॰ 1, 121, 10 । “apIteH saMgrAmAditi” BA॰ ।
m: अपीति f. entering into, RV. i, 121, 10, dissolving, dissolution, ŚBr.; Up.
a: अपीतिः — f. 1 Entering into, approaching. --2 Dissolution, destruction; loss. --3 Destruction of the world (प्रलय); अपीतौ तद्वत् प्रसंगादसमंजसं Br. Sūt. II. 1. 8. --4 Encountering, joining in battle.

m: अ-पीत्वा ind.p. not having drunk, without drinking.

s: tri, atisundaraM । yaTA, -- “apIvyadarSanaM SaSvat sarvvalokanamaskftaM । santaM vayasi kESore BftyAnugrahakAtaraM” ॥ iti SrIBAgavataM ॥
